description: Xena and Gabrielle’s final journeys range from Amphipolis and the Norse lands to Japan, revisiting old debts, gods and relationships as their long partnership reaches its conclusion.

s06e01.description: In “Coming Home”, Xena and Gabrielle face a new conflict shaped by myth, war or Xena’s past, testing how far redemption can survive the consequences of violence.
